lines.text: Emergency lighting flickers on. A cold voice fills the corridor.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Unidentified biological entity detected. Initiating standard containment protocol.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Please remain calm. Resistance will only... complicate things.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: -- if anyone finds this, don't trust the voice. She isn't -- [STATIC] -- not what she says she --
